title: Unit of Work with Savepoints
instructions: Implement `UnitOfWork` and `import_messages` in `uow.py` on top of `sqlite3` with `isolation_level=None`. `begin()` runs BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK, `begin_nested()` runs uniquely named SAVEPOINTs with RELEASE or ROLLBACK TO, and the properties `in_transaction` and `depth` stay correct after exceptions. `import_messages` skips duplicate rows with one savepoint per row inside a single transaction.

evidence.label: import_messages saves new rows and skips only the duplicates
An unexpected error during an import rolls back the whole batch
An outer failure undoes work from already released savepoints
begin() inside begin() raises TransactionAlreadyBegun without disturbing the outer transaction
begin_nested() without a transaction raises NoActiveTransaction
An inner savepoint failure keeps the outer savepoint's work and depth tracks nesting
Raises ValueError unless the connection uses isolation_level=None
BaseException rolls everything back and resets state so a new transaction can begin
Issues BEGIN/COMMIT and uniquely named SAVEPOINT, ROLLBACK TO and RELEASE statements
COMMIT publishes changes to other connections; uncommitted rows are invisible
